housing: Norfolk's rentals include older row houses and converted apartments in Ghent, single-family homes and duplexes, and many apartment complexes serving military families.

climate: Look for water stains, flood lines and mold, and test the AC; Norfolk has humid summers, hurricanes and frequent tidal flooding.
fact: Norfolk is home to Naval Station Norfolk, so many leases follow military moves and include military clauses.
